title: Hindi Ito Marites: Are Filipinos losing trust in news media?
summary: The Philippines saw the biggest decline in trust in news from 2025 to 2026

blocks.text: The Philippines saw the biggest decline in trust in news from 2025 to 2026

The Reuters Digital News Report 2026 showed Filipinos had a sharp drop in trust in news from traditional media sources over the past year. With a decline of 10 percentage points, the Philippines clocked the biggest drop among countries studied.

What does this mean for journalists? For democracy? For Philippine society? And what can be done to remedy the situation? Rappler editor-at-large Marites Vitug draws from experience to address these questions. – Rappler.com
